items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Pettiford was with Barnet with me.

ctx.x: Pettiford was with Barnet with me. I don't know if -- Pettiford might have been on that band. I can't -- I don't recall no Pettiford being with Raeburn. He might have been.
Mert Oliver mentioned you once, and --
